entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sushil Kumar Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Vikas Singh Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the first informant and learned AGA.
Vide order dated 22.10.2021, the dispute had been referred for mediation as it was a matrimonial dispute giving rise to the First Information Report dated 03.08.2021, registered as Case Crime No.
0504 of 2021, under sections 504, 506, 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Fatehpur.
The report of the mediation proceedings has been placed before us.
The report indicates that the mediation failed as the petitioners failed to appear before the Mediation Centre.

In this regard, it is material to reproduce the relevant portion of the order dated 17.10.2022, which Rakesh Keshkar And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120404520/
1 reads as follows:-
"It is made clear that in case there occurs default by the petitioners either in depositing the amount or in appearing before the Mediation Centre on the date fixed,
the interim order shall cease to operate and the Mediation Centre shall immediately communicate with the office which in turn shall list the case within a week before the appropriate Bench for passing orders in the matter."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above and since the mediation has failed, the writ petition is dismissed as the allegation made in the First Information Report constitutes a cognizable offence.
Interim order, if any, stands discharged.
